data.title: 结城美柑 · 浴后走廊的意外跌坐心跳
data.action: 刚沐浴走出浴室，单薄大浴巾松垮掩身，被意外神摔撞倒跌坐在走廊地板，一手撑地一手慌乱掩胸，满面通红嗔斥
data.camera: medium shot, slightly high angle, dynamic fallen pose
data.lighting: 浴室蒸腾的水汽与走廊暖黄壁灯交融
data.location: 结城家二楼铺着光滑实木地板的走廊转角
data.description: 刚刚沐浴完毕的走廊里水汽袅袅。美柑裹着洁白的浴巾正擦拭微湿发梢，转角处迎面撞上急冲而来的梨斗，伴随不可思议的神摔重重跌坐在木地板上。浴巾险险滑落，她一手撑地一手慌张护在胸前，整张脸红透，眼中含着无措的泪花咬牙娇嗔。
data.promptProse: Seated on the wooden hallway floor beside the open bathroom door, Mikan braces her left hand on the floor and holds the upper edge of a large white bath towel closed at her chest with her right. The towel remains wrapped around her torso as steam drifts from the doorway and warm wall lamps catch the water droplets in her wet hair.
data.animaCaption: Her left hand braces on the floor; her right keeps the towel wrapped closed at her chest.
